clues: This small town sits in the Middle Atlas hills. It lies in the north of Morocco, in Africa.
Set high in the mountains, this town stays cool in summer. Visitors come here to escape the heat of the plains below.
The modern town was set up by French rulers in 1929. They set it up to help run the land they ruled.
This town is one of the best known mountain trip spots in all of Morocco. People come to enjoy its high, snowy hills.
This town is the capital of its own province. It is in the Fes-Meknes region in north Morocco.
